class.name: TextSystemAdvanced
class.brief_description: An advanced text server with support for BiDi, complex text layout, and contextual OpenType features. Used in Orblit by default.
class.description: An implementation of [TextSystem] that uses HarfBuzz, ICU and SIL Graphite to support BiDi, complex text layouts and contextual OpenType features. This is Orblit's default primary [TextSystem] interface.
